title: Cloudflare Dashboard Setup for Observatory WebSocket Support

steps.title: Enable WebSockets
steps.description: Enable WebSocket support in Cloudflare dashboard
steps.reason: Required for WebSocket connections through tunnel
steps.expected_result: WebSocket connections will work through tunnel

steps.title: Configure Bot Protection
steps.description: Set up bot protection rules for Observatory
steps.action: Disable Bot Fight Mode for observatory.nkllon.com
steps.reason: Prevents false positives on legitimate polling
steps.expected_result: HTTP polling fallback will not trigger bot protection
steps.verification: Check that HTTP polling requests are not blocked

steps.title: Create WAF Rules
steps.description: Create custom WAF rules for Observatory polling
steps.action: Create rule with Observatory polling conditions
steps.rule_expression:
(http.host eq "observatory.nkllon.com" and
                     http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/" and
                     http.request.headers.x-observatory-client eq "internal-polling")
steps.verification: Check WAF logs for allowed requests

steps.title: Configure Rate Limiting
steps.description: Set appropriate rate limits for Observatory
steps.action: Create rate limit rule for /api/* endpoints
steps.reason: Prevent abuse while allowing legitimate polling
steps.verification: Test rate limiting with multiple requests

steps.title: Firewall Rules
steps.description: Create firewall rules for Observatory traffic
steps.reason: Ensure Observatory traffic is not blocked
steps.rule_expression:
(http.host eq "observatory.nkllon.com" and
                     http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/" and
                     http.request.headers.x-polling-reason eq "websocket-fallback")
steps.expected_result: Observatory traffic is not blocked by firewall
steps.verification: Check firewall logs for allowed traffic

websocket_404.cause: WebSockets not enabled in Cloudflare dashboard

bot_protection_error.solution: Disable Bot Fight Mode and create WAF rules

rate_limiting.solution: Adjust rate limit rules for Observatory
